The '''''Scylla''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]]'s [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] shortly after the [[Black Fleet Crisis]]. This ship was almost captured during a [[Battle of Columus (Galactic Civil War)|battle]] against [[General/Legends|General]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]], who used a pair of [[CC-7700 frigate/Legends|CC-7700 frigates]] to keep it from escaping into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. In an act of desperation, Daala took out one of the frigates by ramming the ''Scylla'' into it. This allowed Daala to jump into hyperspace&mdash;but also severely damaged the ''Scylla's'' navigational systems. Daala's jump was a blind one, and she wasn't seen until the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] at least twenty years later to help out [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] and the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].
